[b]2027/2/26: Horgingtonia[/b]

[spoiler]Lamandicas vision for the oil-centric colony of Horgingtonia in South Vespuria has not gone according to plan. Oil production has been well below expected, and declining. Little people have decided to settle the region, and those who have seemed to have flocked back to mainland Lamandica in droves. Puerto Encarnacion, expected to have 300,000 residents by 2030 has a fraction of that, with a minuscule fraction deciding to stay. Some blame Lamandicas lack of funding to the region, some blame Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz and his politics, and others blame other projects such as Mandalay Bay and Rupert in the mainland receiving priority. Whatever the blame, Lamandica has lost billions in investing in this colony, which Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz no longer views as profitable. However, Horgingtonia mightve just seen its final blow. On Friday, February 26th, 2027, a local tribe of Indigenous people in the region launched a surprise attack on the two largest cities of Horgingtonia, La Cinmexnard and Puerto Encarnacion, killing dozens of Lamandicans before eventually retreating due to a delayed counterattack from the Horgingtonia National Guard. The Indigenous population, present before Lamandicans settled the region, suspected to have attacked due to negative relations with the local governments in Horgingtonia and disregard of the land rights they had over the region. When news broke out, Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz urged any Lamandicans still in the region to travel back to the mainland or find accommodations in nearby nations. With refineries abandoned, infrastructure crumbling, and cities partially destroyed, the Lamandican Parliament will meet sometime in March to discuss if they should cede the region, and what to do regarding the various regions that have rented terminals at Matthew Harbour in Puerto Encarnacion (which werent damaged during the attack). There are also rumours of a potential tax rise to temporarily regain money after the failure of Modern Lamandicas first colony, which have led many angry Lamandicans to vent about the current government and crisis, while also paying their respects to those in Horgingtonia.[/spoiler]
